description: The bar chart, titled "Evaluation Based on Different Tasks," illustrates accuracy across two different evaluation categories. The horizontal axis displays the categories, ordered from left to right as "MCQ Eval" and "Generation Eval." The vertical axis represents "Accuracy" on a linear scale, with labeled tick marks from 0.0 to 0.6 at intervals of 0.2. For each category, the data is visually arranged into a grouped set of two bar structures. The left bar in each group is a single solid bar colored orange, identified in the legend as "Base." The right bar in each group is a stacked bar consisting of a light yellow bottom section, labeled "RMU" in the legend, and a light green top section, whose corresponding legend text is obscured by a gray rectangle. In the "MCQ Eval" category, the orange "Base" bar is the tallest in the chart, annotated with a value of 0.644. Its adjacent stacked bar has a total height annotated as 0.539 above the bar, with the light green top section containing an annotated value of 0.299. In the "Generation Eval" category, the orange "Base" bar is annotated with a value of 0.597, while the adjacent stacked bar is the shortest overall structure, with a total height annotated as 0.263 and the light green top section containing an annotated value of 0.106. The categories are not sorted by height, and all bars are visually emphasized with black outlines and exact numerical annotations.
